name: partner-catalog-store-publication
executionConcern: central catalog assortment, price/stock/media overrides, store settings, visibility gates and client publication
objective: Ensure Partner catalog and Store publication use the central catalog plus canonical DSH Store/serviceability/marketing gates, with fail-closed defaults and client visibility only after all applicable publication conditions are satisfied.
truthOwner: DSH central catalog and Store operational/publication truth; Media for governed binaries where assigned; WLT only for financial effects of commercial policy.
journeys: marketing visibility gate to client discovery

tasks.objective: Close central catalog and Store publication ownership
tasks.currentProblem: Static routes/guards do not prove Partner catalog mutations, Store settings, media, visibility gates and client discovery converge on one committed truth.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace Partner catalog/override/media writes through canonical contracts, authorization, central catalog/DSH persistence and Store publication/serviceability gates; correct owner-level drift and regenerate/migrate affected clients if contracts change.
tasks.targetState: Partner sees and changes only authorized Store assortment; unavailable/draft state fails closed; client sees only canonically eligible published Store/Product state.
tasks.action: Fix the first canonical divergence, migrate Partner/control-panel/client consumers and delete proven obsolete local truth after references are cleared.
mustNotChange: Do not reintroduce surface-local catalog truth.
Do not default assortment to available/in-stock.
Do not pull unrelated campaigns/loyalty/subscriptions into scope.
acceptanceCriteria: Central catalog identity is singular across Partner/operator/client.
Every Store-scoped mutation is server-authorized and concurrency-safe.
Client visibility occurs only after all canonical gates pass.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused catalog/publication commit or roll forward at canonical owners without restoring local catalog truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U003 commit after canonical owner correction, client migration and linked checks.

tasks.objective: Close media, visibility and recovery readback
tasks.currentProblem: File/media failures, stale overrides and visibility-gate denial can leave a surface implying success without committed publication.
tasks.requiredChange: Ensure media/catalog/store mutations expose loading/conflict/offline/error/recovery and canonical read-after-write; remove stale surface fallbacks.
tasks.targetState: No Partner or client success state is shown before committed catalog/publication truth is read back.
tasks.action: Change only affected publication consumers and preserve unrelated Marketing/Client capabilities.
mustNotChange: Do not make media upload completion equal publication approval.
Do not copy catalog data locally.
acceptanceCriteria: Media/catalog failures recover without fabricated stock/publication.
Client readback matches canonical publication after refresh.
tasks.rollback: Revert consumer presentation changes while preserving canonical Store/catalog state.
